metadata.page_title: Nacua-Cola vs In Purdytory matchup report

summary.decision_summary: Nacua-Cola won by 12.2. Nacua-Cola left 26.5 lineup points on the table, while In Purdytory left 44.5.
summary.historical_summary: Nacua-Cola is 22-25 against In Purdytory across 47 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor In Purdytory
summary.winner_reason: Nacua-Cola won by 12.2 after scoring -21.4 against projection. The leading starters were Bhayshul Tuten (16.2) and Brandon Aubrey (16.0).
summary.loser_reason: In Purdytory lost by 12.2 while finishing 37.2 below projection. Lions scored -2.0. Its best legal lineup added 44.5, enough to put the lineup decisions directly in the result.
